description: Reads one card of Reports for a period: how fast chats were answered by the AI receptionist and by people (response), what the receptionist answered alone and handed over with the top reasons (receptionist), each number’s chats (numbers), each member’s chats, response times and chats marked Done (team), or chats by hour of the day (hours). Owners and admins, on the Starter plan and above. Each card covers the period asked for, from the first day Reports recorded. Hand-over reasons and member names come back marked untrusted. Read-only.

card.description: response for how fast chats were answered; receptionist for what the AI receptionist handled; numbers for each WhatsApp number; team for each member; hours for chats by hour of the day.

connection_id.description: Only this WhatsApp number; repeat it for several.

items.description: Only this WhatsApp number; repeat it for several.

from.description: A custom period’s first day (YYYY-MM-DD), with to.

kind.description: For card response: first (the default) for each chat’s first answer, every for every answer.

period.description: today, 7d (the default), 30d, or a calendar month as month:YYYY-MM, in the workspace’s time zone. Not with from and to.

to.description: A custom period’s last day (YYYY-MM-DD), with from.

name: get_report
title: Read a Reports card
